name: otame4-work-skills
description: Practical Agent Skills for Japanese job hunting and career change: self-analysis, document review, interviews, company research, offer decisions, Otameshi Tenshoku trial planning for candidates, and the employer side of a trial from work design and listing to applicant replies, contract terms and feedback.

plugins.name: otame4-trial
plugins.description: Otameshi Tenshoku for job seekers: applications, clarifying trial conditions, learning visits, paid trial work scope, workload, duration, compensation, and the post-trial decision. (1 skill)

plugins.name: otame4-employer
plugins.description: Otameshi Tenshoku for employers: designing the trial work and its cost, drafting and checking the listing, making the internal budget case, replying to applicants, stating gyomu-itaku terms in writing before the start, and debriefing with feedback that keeps settlement apart from evaluation. (6 skills)

plugins.name: otame4-career
plugins.description: Career conversations from uncertainty to next steps: weighing a job change, exploring roles through evidence and small experiments, taking stock of experience, building checkable employer criteria, and laying out how a search runs alongside a current job. (5 skills)

plugins.name: otame4-documents
plugins.description: Entry sheets, rirekisho, and shokumu-keirekisho: drafting and review against the question asked, the evidence available, and the character limit. (1 skill)

plugins.name: otame4-research
plugins.description: Company research from primary and official sources with every claim dated and attributed, close reading of a Japanese job posting's pay and requirements, and triage of incoming scout messages by what they actually disclose. (3 skills)

plugins.name: otame4-interview
plugins.description: Interview preparation that starts from the documents already submitted, and a debrief that turns what happened into what to fix before the next round. (2 skills)

plugins.name: otame4-offer
plugins.description: Offer decisions and the exits: checking the conditions an employer has stated in writing, putting several offers on one basis, declining the rest, and planning the resignation and the move. (4 skills)

plugins.name: otame4-sidework
plugins.description: Side work alongside a main job: reading the employer's own rules on whether side work is prohibited, needs permission, or only a notification, and checking what a gyomu-itaku assignment has actually put in writing about scope, fee, payment due date, and rights. (2 skills)
